metadata.macro_summary_en: The market is firmly in a risk-on mode, as reflected by a 73/100 Fear & Greed index. Institutional capital is aggressively long gold, GBP and USDJPY, while shorting EURUSD, indicating a broad appetite for higher‑yielding assets and a strong US dollar. Retail positioning largely mirrors or slightly opposes these smart‑money flows, creating short‑term contrarian opportunities. Liquidity remains ample, supporting continued equity and commodity rally, but watch for potential overextension in the USD and commodity space.
metadata.macro_summary_fa: بازار در وضعیت ریسک‑آن قرار دارد؛ شاخص ترس و طمع ۷۳ از ۱۰۰ نشان‌دهنده تمایل قوی سرمایه‌گذاران به ریسک است. سرمایه‌های نهادی به‌صورت گسترده در طلا، پوند و دلار/ین موقعیت‌های خرید دارند و در یورو/دلار موقعیت‌های فروش، که نشانگر تقاضای بالا برای دارایی‌های پر بازده و دلار قوی است. موقعیت‌های خرده‌فروشان عمدتاً با این جریان‌ها همسو یا کمی مخالف هستند و فرصت‌های کوتاه‌مدت ضد‌جریان ایجاد می‌کند. نقدینگی همچنان فراوان است و از ادامه روند صعودی سهام و کالاها حمایت می‌کند، اما باید از فشار بیش از حد بر دلار و کالاها هشیار بود.

XAUUSD.name: Gold / US Dollar
XAUUSD.aiSmartMoneyVerdict: Institutions hold a net long of +245,800 contracts and 76% of them are long, signaling strong conviction in gold as a hedge and inflation play. Retail is modestly long (54%) but far less aggressive, suggesting smart money is driving the rally.
XAUUSD.contrarianWarning: Retail bias is only mildly long; a sudden shift to short positions could trigger a short‑squeeze, so be wary of a potential contrarian unwind if gold spikes sharply.

EURUSD.name: Euro / US Dollar
EURUSD.aiSmartMoneyVerdict: The smart‑money side is net short -42,500 contracts with 62% of institutions short, indicating a bearish outlook on the euro against the dollar, likely driven by divergent monetary policy and stronger US yields.
EURUSD.contrarianWarning: Retail is 68% long, creating a classic long‑biased crowd. A rapid move lower could trap these retail longs, so watch for a short‑squeeze if the dollar rallies further.

GBPUSD.name: British Pound / US Dollar
GBPUSD.aiSmartMoneyVerdict: Institutions are net long +18,200 contracts and 58% long, reflecting confidence in the pound despite mixed retail sentiment. The modest institutional long suggests a measured but positive bias.
GBPUSD.contrarianWarning: Retail is almost evenly split (51% long), so a sudden swing toward the dollar could catch the small retail long side off‑guard; monitor for short‑covering spikes.

USDJPY.name: US Dollar / Japanese Yen
USDJPY.aiSmartMoneyVerdict: Smart money is heavily long USDJPY with a net +89,400 contracts and 68% of institutions long, underscoring a strong USD bias amid higher US rates and yen carry trade unwind.
USDJPY.contrarianWarning: Retail is 69% short, meaning a rapid USD rally could squeeze retail shorts; be alert to sharp upside moves that may trigger a short‑covering rally.
